title: Power

text.ms: Solar panels make power. A battery stores extra power for later. Machines use power every sol. Game rule: when power runs short, life support gets it first. Check the Power row on the Monitor to see what you make and what you use.

source: docs/design/landing-spec.md section 5.3 with the Instructional Designer changes W1 to W7 (section 12). 24 h 40 min in journal.sol, the Earth line and its HS sentence in journal.dome.stable are pending SME confirmation (unverified).
